title: A.R.M.O.R. state of a Zigbee sensor, told to the panel of an alarm node
description: What the server tells an ARMOR-ALARM panel about the Zigbee sensor linked to one of its zones, on armor/alarm/{node_id}/zigbee (never retained), while the server holds the Zigbee radio: the zone, whether its sensor is normal, triggered or tampered with, and whether its battery is low. It is information towards the panel and never a command: it cannot arm, disarm or sound anything by itself. The node of the topic is the panel's; the message does not repeat it.
